summary: Afore Capital is a pre-seed firm that describes itself on its homepage as a $500,000,000 fund investing $500,000 to more than $2,000,000 in pre-traction companies, with a founders-in-residence programme for people who are not yet sure their idea is venture-ready. The portfolio page tags investments by region (Bay Area, New York, Canada, Denver) and category (SaaS, consumer, fintech, AI) but the site does not state a sector or geographic mandate, an application form or a street address.

investmentEvidence.fact: Portfolio page marks Hightouch (customer data syncing) as an Afore pre-seed investment. The date is not stated.
Portfolio page marks the AI presentation tool as an Afore pre-seed investment. The date is not stated.
